facets.description: Office365 createEvent (lines 73–77) targets the first destination instead of the creating credential's destination.
Lark createEvent (lines 128–129) targets the first destination instead of the creating credential's destination.
BaseCalendarService event creation (lines 156–164) filters calendars using the first destination instead of the creating credential's destination.
Lark createAttendees (lines 164–165) also selects the first destination's calendar.
The stored booking reference records the member's destination externalId while creation uses the first destination, breaking subsequent updates and deletes.
